questions.question: Isaac meets Su for the first time. Which greeting should he use?
questions.explanation: Mingalaba (မင်္ဂလာပါ) is the standard polite greeting in Burmese. It can be used throughout the day.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence:

'Kyun naw na me _____ ba.'
questions.explanation: When introducing yourself, you place your name after 'na me'. Example: Kyun naw na me Isaac ba.

questions.question: What does 'Twe ya da wan tha ba de.' mean?
questions.explanation: This is a common phrase used when meeting someone for the first time.

questions.question: How do you say 'Thank you' in Burmese?
questions.explanation: Kyay Zu Tin Bar De (ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ်) means 'Thank you'.

questions.question: Which Burmese phrase means 'Yes'?
questions.explanation: Hote De (ဟုတ်တယ်) means 'Yes'.

questions.question: Which Burmese phrase means 'No'?
questions.explanation: Ma Hote Bue (မဟုတ်ဘူး) means 'No'.

questions.question: Which phrase means 'I don't know'?
questions.explanation: Ma Thi Bue (မသိဘူး) means 'I don't know'.

questions.question: Which sentence order does Burmese usually follow?
questions.explanation: Unlike English, Burmese usually follows Subject + Object + Verb (SOV).

questions.question: Which Burmese word means 'Hello'?
options: ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ်
questions.explanation: မင်္ဂလာပါ is read as 'Mingalaba' and means 'Hello'.

questions.question: You're leaving after your first Burmese lesson. What should you say to Su?
questions.explanation: At the end of the lesson, thanking your teacher with 'Kyay Zu Tin Bar De' is the most appropriate response.
